depiction.primary_object: person lying in a bed beneath an airplane
depiction.composition: two stacked symbols: airplane angled up-right above a side-view bed with sleeping figure

readings.meaning: flight and hotel package / travel booking
overnight flight / red-eye flight / lie-flat seat

ambiguity: Combines two distinct travel concepts (flights and lodging), so it can mean either a bundled flight+hotel booking, an airport hotel, or sleeping on a red-eye flight.

modifier_semantics.meaning: combines air travel with accommodation or sleeping

reasoning: Shows an airplane above a person in bed, the standard pictogram for flight+hotel travel packages, airport transit hotels, or overnight travel logistics. It is highly distinctive and fits real trip-planning and expense-reporting tasks where both airfare and lodging are handled together, whereas plain flight-only or hotel-only tasks belong to the single airplane or bed icons.
